authority.request_scope: Prepare one v2-specific refinement/comparison contract, preregister the future defect and criteria, and distinguish proposed definitions from approved inputs.
authority.definition_owner: Operator; no new operator approval is inferred from this research request.
authority.proposal_scope: A typed deterministic-state-map and observable-pullback interface is proposed below. It is not a selected map or a theorem of its existence.
authority.integrity_only: A checksum of this draft or its run identifies reviewed bytes only; it is never an operative source-owned comparison pin.
authority.r570_role: Finite source-specific operator identities only. No comparison, common limiting space or limit theorem is imported.
authority.previous_models: No old PAH, Q3LOCK or TECT-YM comparison implementation or PASS is imported.

immutable_model.functional: Evaluate exactly the v1 formula incorporated by the pinned v2; no counterterm or changed finite part.
immutable_model.rates: Keep the v2 directed labelled PH/TR/LK/AP roots, per-root mobility exponent nu and rate formula. No aggregation correction, fitting or time acceleration.
immutable_model.states: At each rho use exactly X_rho=Omega_v2(rho,Q_rho), with all (j,ell,n,u) labels retained, and pi_rho=exp(-beta F_rho)/Z_rho on tuple counting.
immutable_model.projection: Keep the complete finite gauge and anchor-preserving cell-automorphism averages P_rho. Do not reduce the symmetry group to make a map pass.
immutable_model.time_boundary: External stochastic t, stationary X_0 distributed as pi_rho, no terminal conditioning.
immutable_model.common_norm: The inherited supremum norm, not a substituted Gibbs-L2 norm. Gibbs-L2 is separately reported only as a weaker diagnostic.
immutable_model.root_pairing: Root space weighted by pi_rho per valid directed label; sqrt(c/2) occurs in B, not a second time in the measure.

tower_contract.indices: rho_(j,h,N): j is local-state-cutoff index, h is lattice-refinement index, N is volume/exhaustion index. These are not n_v or a time variable.
tower_contract.geometry_input: One executable, intrinsic anchored two-cell-complex family G_(h,N), oriented incidence and nonempty closed face words, explicit O_(h,N), C_(h,N), a uniform degree bound and cellular transport for all adjacent levels. Physical dimension/length/volume is not assigned.
tower_contract.local_state_input: At each fixed (h,N), executable cofinal sequences K_j,M_s,j,M_psi,j,R_max,j and an explicit Q_(j,h,N) rule. All four cutoffs must be unbounded. Admissibility is checked at every declared level; no fixed R_max or undeclared diagonal.
tower_contract.charge_rule: Every actual comparison must map a valid fine fixed-Q tuple to a valid coarse fixed-Q tuple. Neither copying Q nor rescaling it is inferred. A proposed Q schedule must be separately exposed for owner approval and cannot change the Gibbs formula.
tower_contract.boundaries: Finite O,C remain labels, not fixed fields. Specify the transported anchors, all terminal faces, new cells and the boundary shell; no periodic, conditioned or neutral-boundary replacement is implicit.
tower_contract.couplings: All inserted couplings, nu and rate scales stay frozen across each comparison. Only explicitly listed regulator components vary.
tower_contract.lattice_volume_warning: The parent's fixed physical-volume target is not an identified physical quantity in v2. A combinatorial target and its relation, if any, must be supplied, not silently identified with |V| or a^d|V|.

ordered_limits.meaning: j tends to infinity at fixed h,N first; only the subsequent objects may be used for h and then N limits. Ground state is conditional on a separate requested ground-state statement. No interchange is registered.
ordered_limits.time_step: No mathematical time-step regulator; if a numerical splitting is later used its zero-step limit precedes these limits.
ordered_limits.later_stage_boundary: Phase-selector action and later collapse/ground/time observables are not instantiated here. In particular do not insert a source term to implement the inherited selector placeholder.
ordered_limits.current_scope: Definitions and readiness checks only. None of the listed limits is executed or certified.

comparison_interface.state_map: p_(sigma,rho): X_sigma -> X_rho, fine to coarse, total and surjective, independent of f, t and observed verifier outcomes. Its coordinate algorithm is a missing proposed definition, not a forgetful default.
comparison_interface.observable_map: I_(rho,sigma): A_rho -> A_sigma, A_rho=C^(X_rho), (I f)(x)=f(p_(sigma,rho)(x)); coarse to fine. This is the proposed comparison class, not an admitted implementation.
comparison_interface.composition: p_(rho,rho)=id and p_(tau,rho)=p_(sigma,rho) composed with p_(tau,sigma), including commuting refinement squares. Hence I_(rho,tau)=I_(sigma,tau) I_(rho,sigma), once the state-map identities are established.
comparison_interface.state_pushforward: p_* pi_sigma is a probability on X_rho. It is a comparison output, not a replacement for pi_rho. Record their discrepancy separately; no Gibbs projectivity is assumed.
comparison_interface.label_fidelity: Specify the image of every j,ell,n,u coordinate, including ell=0 and epsilon=1. No value-quotient, hidden charge sink or removal of signed K=2 channels.
comparison_interface.symmetry: Supply actual symmetry transport/equivariance or a direct proof that I maps A_rho^inv into A_sigma^inv. Test the full source automorphism groups, not only adjacency or a convenient subgroup.
comparison_interface.kernel_warning: If two formulas agree only on X_rho, I must not distinguish them on X_sigma. A lift on syntactic formulas with no quotient check is not a map on A_rho.

root_correspondence.required_data: For each fine valid incidence (x,s), a deterministic assignment to one valid coarse directed label r at p(x), or UNPAIRED. Paired endpoints must obey p(sx)=r p(x). Store every unmatched incidence and every unmatched coarse label.
root_correspondence.multiplicity: Assignments never merge the state-space root labels or alter their rates. Several fine incidences may contribute to a coarse channel only as an explicitly retained sum. No division by preimage size.
root_correspondence.inverse: For paired incidences check inverse labels and endpoints. Reversed stored edge orientations change TR/LK signs as in v2. Endpoint equality is not equality of roots, rates or root Hilbert measures.
root_correspondence.paths: A coarse root represented by several fine moves is a path, not one fine generator summand. No compound move or new rate is inserted to repair a mismatch.

common_cylinder.definition: After the proposed maps are actually instantiated and their algebra, composition, symmetry and support conditions checked, define D as the algebraic direct limit of the full bounded invariant finite-support observable algebras under I. Until then D is a target definition, not an existing common core.
common_cylinder.support_rule: The packet must give a computable transported finite support S_sigma(f) and a support-based stabilization index. It must include every local observable admitted by the source, not only constants, radial tests or a hand-picked finite family.
common_cylinder.norm: ||[f]||=||f||_(infinity,X_rho). Surjectivity of p is an obligation making this norm independent of representative; a non-surjective map requires review, not an unannounced quotient norm.
common_cylinder.finite_generator_domains: D(L_rho)=A_rho=C^(X_rho), with the source invariant restriction. No domain for an infinite operator is claimed.

preregistered_tests.exact_defect: Delta_(rho,sigma) f = L_sigma I_(rho,sigma) f - I_(rho,sigma) L_rho f, an element of A_sigma; both terms use the original finite generators.
preregistered_tests.expanded_defect: At x: sum_(s valid at x)c_sigma,s(x)[f(p(sx))-f(px)] - sum_(r valid at px)c_rho,r(px)[f(r px)-f(px)]. Unpaired roots stay in these sums.
preregistered_tests.sup_defect: e_(rho,sigma)(f)=max_(x in X_sigma)|Delta_(rho,sigma)f(x)|, not an expectation or a fitted tolerance.
preregistered_tests.gibbs_diagnostic: e2_(rho,sigma)(f)=(sum_x pi_sigma(x)|Delta f(x)|^2)^(1/2), reported separately. An exact nonzero defect does not alone refute vanishing e2 along a sequence.
preregistered_tests.state_defect: b_(rho,sigma)(f)=|sum_x pi_sigma(x) f(p(x))-sum_y pi_rho(y) f(y)|. No vanishing or Radon-Nikodym bound is assumed.
preregistered_tests.eventual_exact_target: For every finite-support f, supply an explicit stabilization level and prove Delta=0 for all subsequent adjacent comparisons in that stage, respecting the j-before-h-before-N order.
preregistered_tests.controlled_target: A separately named weaker target requires a derived bound e<=b(f;rho,sigma) with ordered vanishing and declared uniformity set. Do not call it eventual exact agreement or upgrade a finite estimate to a limit.
falsifiers: A valid fine tuple has no valid coarse image
Composition, invariant-algebra or support compatibility fails
A missing/merged directed channel or a changed rate is used
A nonzero exact defect at an admitted pair refutes that pair only; eventual failure requires arbitrarily late violations for one fixed f
An asymptotic lower bound in the specified norm refutes only that norm's convergence target
A requested generator limit remains unsupported by static state convergence or R-570 alone

readiness.reentry: A completed v2-specific tower/map/root proposal and explicit approval of its exact bytes. Review changed definitions only; do not repeat owner searches or the R-570 finite proof.
readiness.next_single_question: Which concrete v2-only cofinal tower and total charge-safe state map instantiate this pullback contract while retaining the full invariant cylinder algebra?
readiness.review_budget: One definition-design checkpoint before operator review. No dynamic comparison run before admission.
readiness.approved_contract_checks: After approval: primary definition checks, independently authored mathematical/implementation audit, hostile checks and an explicit Lean scope disposition. Passing a schema checker is not such an audit.

verification_scope.draft_check: Source hashes, unchanged order and norm, complete typed fields, truthful unresolved-input states, and fail-closed rejection of common authority/direction/measure shortcuts.
verification_scope.hostile_mathematical_review: NOT_RUN_NO_APPROVED_INSTANTIATION; draft author objections are separate
verification_scope.Lean: NOT_RUN_NO_APPROVED_INSTANTIATION; R-570 Lean lemmas are not comparison proofs.
